description: Rewrite the direction bullet so the model classifies the question by its Convention line, not by the word 'statistically'. If the Convention defines 'favors' as direction of the result, it gets the direction prior (raised to about 0.7), never the p<0.05 prior. [round 2, Direction-only 'favors intervention' question (defined by its Convention) treated as a p<0.05 question, so the 0.4 significance prior was used instead of the direction prior]
